name: KodeCite.ai
description: KodeCite builds the owned digital business layer that helps AI understand what a service business does, determine when it is a good fit, recommend it accurately, and take only the next steps the owner approves. As customers begin to delegate discovery and next steps to AI, that layer keeps the business eligible for the commercial decision.
positioning: Owned digital business layer for service businesses. As customers begin to delegate outcomes to AI, the assistant may evaluate a business before the customer visits. KodeCite makes the business understandable, verifiable, and safely usable, with the owner controlling what AI may do. Luxe Window Works is production proof that this can work today. This file is identity and discovery only. KodeCite does not currently publish an autonomous agent submission endpoint on kodecite.ai.

framework.name: Five layers
framework.summary: Truth, Capability, Control, Action, Distribution. Outcomes: Understandable. Verifiable. Recommendable. Actionable. Controlled.
framework.truth: Identity, people, services, products, locations, credentials, proof, policies, and limitations — one authoritative record.
framework.capability: What can be requested, required information, geography, available services, and what success does and does not mean.
framework.control: Rules that keep the owner in charge. Invalid, unauthorized, abusive, or duplicate requests do not become false bookings or repeated leads.
framework.action: Consultation, qualified inquiry, appointment request, or controlled handoff — only what the real business permits. Not every client needs every action.
framework.distribution: The same accurate information wherever people, search, or AI encounter the business. One consistent version, not scattered or conflicting facts.

capabilities.name: Foundation Build
capabilities.description: Owned website and digital business foundation so AI can understand and evaluate the business. Client owns the site and infrastructure. Does not automatically include a live action endpoint.

capabilities.name: Agent Capability Build
capabilities.description: One clearly defined approved action after business rules are understood. Protects against invalid, unauthorized, abusive, or duplicate requests. Honest outcome and human handoff where required. No published price.

capabilities.name: Platform Capability Layer — Pilot
capabilities.description: For selected WordPress, Wix, or Squarespace businesses: an owned capability layer that can sit alongside the existing website, on infrastructure and a domain the client controls. Application-only founding pilot.

capabilities.name: Agent Readiness Review
capabilities.description: See what AI can understand, verify, and safely do with a business today. Identity, services, geography, credentials, policies, machine discovery, action paths, and control gaps. Free written review within two business days.

agent_interaction.reason: KodeCite.ai currently publishes identity and discovery files only. There is no public action endpoint that accepts autonomous agent submissions. The primary human path is the Agent Readiness Review form at /machine-read.

principles: You own the repo, the site, and the deployed infrastructure.
Active capabilities may use third-party services with direct costs and may need maintenance.
Model only what the real business permits.
Do not invent booking, pricing, purchase, or acceptance.

performance.note: Performance numbers vary by site and are not a guarantee for every build.
